name: Dark Harbor
summary:
A forgotten home, A dark history and a truth waiting to be uncovered.

Step into an old rundown house and uncover the secrets hidden within its decaying walls. Explore every room, investigate strange clues, and interact with any object in your surroundings as you piece together the events that led to the home's mysterious past.
